metadata.description: Claude Code hook plugins for terminal titles, uncertainty detection, session housekeeping, and agent resume guards.

plugins.name: terminal-title
plugins.description: Sets the terminal tab title to reflect current Claude Code activity.

plugins.name: stop-reminders
plugins.description: Detects uncertain language in Claude's responses and reminds it to investigate before guessing.

plugins.name: session-start-housekeeping
plugins.description: Creates temp directories, cleans stale dist artifacts, and removes ephemeral config files on session start.

plugins.name: agent-resume-guard
plugins.description: Blocks Agent resume calls to prevent polling loops on background agents.
